description: The 'dss_llmusage_analysis' dataset provides a comprehensive overview of the usage of large language models (LLMs) across various projects and platforms. It is designed to help understand how different LLMs are utilized within different projects, the types of objects they are associated with, and the providers of these models. This dataset can be particularly useful for organizations looking to optimize their use of LLMs, track performance across different providers, and make informed decisions about future LLM integrations. The dataset includes detailed information about the project keys, object types, and specific LLM identifiers, as well as the connection names and providers. This allows for a granular analysis of LLM deployment and usage patterns, which can be critical for improving efficiency and effectiveness in AI-driven projects. The dataset's unique feature is its ability to link specific LLMs to their respective projects and providers, offering insights into the distribution and diversity of LLM applications.
shortDesc: Dataset analyzing LLM usage across projects and providers.
